data.title: NetzMuster price increase from 1 April 2026
data.summary: NetzMuster GmbH announces that the monthly base price of your "Muster DSL 250" plan rises from €39.99 to €44.99 from 1 April 2026. You have a special right to cancel (Sonderkündigungsrecht).
data.explanation: Your internet provider is raising your monthly price by €5.00. Because of this, you may cancel the contract without notice period and without costs within three months after you receive this letter, at the earliest when the increase takes effect. You can decide whether to cancel or stay; the app shows until when the special cancellation right applies. If you do nothing, the contract continues at the new price. You could compare other providers before deciding.
